findings.quote: Pan salt would not hold a stamp through a wet season, and nobody paid the extra to try.
findings.problem: Coast-pans unstamped salt bars are an unattested elaboration; wiki attests only Nalun's stamped standard bars (The Kingdom of Nalun; Material Index T0-T4). Not a contradiction.
